name: Ironheart
description_md:
Ironheart Beginner Deck
Ironheart (Riri Williams) is one of the young promises of the Marvel universe, equipped with high-tech armor that improves as she progresses in her fight against crime. This deck is designed for beginners, offering a balanced combination of attack, defense and support, ideal for learning the mechanics of the game and enjoying the evolution of the character.

Main Strategy:
Ironheart is a unique hero in Marvel Champions due to his ability to evolve throughout the game, going through three different versions (version I, version II and version III). The main goal of this deck is to make the most of this progression to increase Ironheart's power and dominate both minions and villains.

Game strategy:
Early Stage:

Focus on getting progress counters quickly using cards like Technological Progress and Fly Over.
Prioritize protection and threat control to maintain stability as you develop.
Middle Stage:

Once you've advanced to version II, start balancing between attacking the minions and the villain.
Use support cards and equipment to strengthen Ironheart and prepare for the final stage.
Final stage:

When you reach version III, max out your attacks and use cards like Plasma Blasters and Photon Beam to deal massive damage.
Make the most of your skills and events to ensure victory.
Recommendations:
Resource Management: Make sure you use your cards efficiently, balancing between attacks, defense and progression.
Villain Lore: Understand the mechanics of the villain you face to anticipate their moves and plan your actions accordingly.
Adaptability: Don't hesitate to adjust your strategy according to the development of the game. Flexibility is key to handling different situations that may arise.
With this deck and strategy, you'll be well prepared to take full advantage of Ironheart's abilities and enjoy Marvel Champions as you become a powerful hero in the Marvel universe. Good luck and have fun playing!
